title: Namecheap nameservers for heywobo.com
detail: Not 'Personal DNS Server'. Domain List → Manage → Domain tab → Nameservers row → Custom DNS → ns1.vercel-dns.com, ns2.vercel-dns.com → green tick.

title: api.heywobo.com in Railway
detail: Service wobo → Settings → Networking → Custom Domain → api.heywobo.com. Paste the CNAME target it shows.

title: heywobo.com in Resend
detail: Domains → Add domain → heywobo.com. Paste or screenshot the DNS records it shows.
